content.title: When Does ‘The Bachelorette’ Premiere? Season 22 Date, Time and Details
content.text: Key PointsSeason 22 of The Bachelorette premieres March 22, 2026, starring Taylor Frankie Paul.The show's new season moves from January to March and switches to Sunday nights.This season features a non-Bachelor Nation lead and 22 diverse male contestants. If you’ve been waiting for the next season of The Bachelorette, the premiere is finally just around the corner. Season 22 of The Bachelorette, starring The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives star Taylor Frankie Paul, premieres Sunday, March 22, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET/PT on ABC. Episodes will stream the next day on Hulu.Read More Related: Will ABC Cancel Taylor Frankie Paul’s ‘Bachelorette’ Season After New Investigation? The upcoming season marks a major change for the long-running franchise, which traditionally launches a new Bachelor or Bachelorette season in early January. This year, however, ABC shifted the schedule, pushing the premiere to March and moving the show to a brand-new night. Why ‘The Bachelorette’ Didn’t Premiere in January For years, Bachelor Nation fans could count on a new season arriving the first Monday of January. That didn’t happen in 2026 for two main reasons. First, ABC and ESPN hold the broadcast rights to the College Football Playoff, including the national championship game, which aired Monday, Jan. 19. Rather than compete with one of the biggest sports broadcasts of the year, the network appears to have delayed the franchise’s return. Second, ABC reorganized its reality-TV schedule. Related: All the Taylor Frankie Paul ‘Bachelorette’ Spoilers — Including Who Made the Final 3 Instead of airing The Bachelorette on Mondays, the network shifted the show to Sunday nights beginning this spring. The move opened Mondays for American Idol, which premiered Jan. 26 and now anchors the network’s Monday lineup. Meanwhile, NBC’s rival singing competition The Voice returned Feb. 23. In other words, ABC was positioning American Idol directly against The Voice while giving The Bachelorette a fresh night of its own. Related: ‘The Bachelorette’ Season 22 Cast Revealed: ‘The Book of More-Men’ is Now Open Who Is the New Bachelorette? Season 22 features a notable departure for the franchise: the lead comes from outside Bachelor Nation. Taylor Frankie Paul is best known as a breakout star of the Hulu reality series The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives. The Utah-based influencer rose to internet fame during the “MomTok” viral saga and has built a massive TikTok following with her candid storytelling about relationships, motherhood and personal growth. According to ABC, the 31-year-old single mom is hoping to leave headline-making drama behind and focus on finding lasting love. Related: ‘Bachelorette’ Taylor Frankie Paul Deletes Steamy IG Story—Fans Are Convinced They Know Who’s in It The Men Competing for Taylor’s Final Rose ABC has revealed the 22 men who will compete for Paul’s heart this season. The group includes a wide range of careers and personalities, from a cowboy entrepreneur and ocean lifeguard to a former professional baseball player and a three-time Paralympian. Among the contestants are: Aaron, 32, a product manager from Utah Brad, 29, a cowboy from California Doug, 28, an ocean lifeguard from San Diego Johnnie, 30, a former pro baseball player Trenten, 35, a professional athlete and Paralympian You can see the full list of contestants and their bios here. Related: ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Welcoming ‘The Bachelorette’ For an ‘Insane’ Group Date When Does ‘The Bachelorette’ Air Each Week? Once the season premieres, new episodes of The Bachelorette will air Sundays at 8 p.m. ET/PT on ABC and stream the next day on Hulu.
